scaleBeatText: A man, maybe 40s, with a nervous tic walks away from Haven. They don't look back.

⛓️ Thornfield doesn't say no. They say: "They'll take Haven — but the tribute is 6,000 kcal/week, not 5,000. Take it or leave it." The table is set — accept their terms, sweeten the offer, or walk away.
🚶 Haven walks from the table cleanly — no blades, no hard words. The bond ends where it stood, honestly.

📯 Stonebridge's court summons Haven's speaker. SWEAR the oath of the realm (a gift seals it), SERVE at their court (seven days of your speaker's life), or WALK — break the link and stay a free fire, refusing the scale itself with it (the offer does not return). Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.
🚶 Haven walks from the table cleanly — no blades, no hard words. The bond ends where it stood, honestly.
🚶 Haven walks away from Stonebridge's table — a free fire, whatever that costs. The realm continues without you.
◈ SYSTEM: "Noted. The offer is withdrawn — permanently. No court. No oath. No tithe. The audience is... divided. Half of them just subscribed."

🚶 Haven refuses the scale. Every kcal stays in Haven's pantry — no one's court, no one's oath, no pool shares, no tariffs. The price, said plainly: no polity logistics (tribute comes in whole, never ×1.25), no league to call when the late waves come, and the table stays distant. Coalition or death — Haven walks it alone.
Almost nobody walks away from this one.

With Haven grieving, Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.
📺 The billing says EXTREME RISK — almost nobody walks away from this one.
Almost nobody walks away from this one.

Seven days of silence, and the silence answered for Haven. Stonebridge's new speaker reads it plainly. (Trust -6.) Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table after all — tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief became leverage, and they knew it would.
Almost nobody walks away from this one.
With Haven grieving, Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 11,250 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.

◈ THE TABLE — the ring of pale light flickers at the edge of the sky... and does not come. The System does not apologize this time. "WE PRICED THE RUN. NO HUNGER ON THE RECORD — THE PELLET HUMS WHERE THE FIRE SHOULD BE. NO FEAST, NO SURGE, NOTHING HERE WE CAN PRICE. A COLD SPOT AT EVERY TABLE: THE WORDS WERE ON THE WRAPPER." The ledger still wants: the food-thesis deeds (no feast can carry the surge while the pellet hums). The mantle may pass to hungrier hands; the table will still be here.
